It packages the app with its exact runtime environment, ensuring consistent behavior across machines
It replaces the need for a process manager entirely
It makes JavaScript compile to native code

Deploy immediately with no testing

Force a hard crash for logging purposes
Restart the process indefinitely

APM tools replace the need for a health endpoint entirely

Only the linting step

It replaces the need for automated testing entirely
